description:
A powerful app to customize & extend Google Calendar.


### Highlights
• **Editing events** – now opens a compact overlay similar to the overlay for creating events instead of the edit event page
• **Creating events** – the new event overlay now shows all of its fields from the start and matches the look of the edit overlay
• **Place details** – when you open an event, clicking its location shows a map, plus photos, website and phone number for businesses
• **Room bookings** – while you pick rooms, a booked room's other bookings show in gray on the calendar, named for who booked them instead of "busy"
• **Faster & smoother** – flipping through the calendar is snappier, the sidebar and overlays move smoothly, and memory usage no longer keeps growing

### Also in this release

#### Added
• Hold <kbd>Option</kbd>/<kbd>Alt</kbd> when navigating your calendar to jump a larger step, like a month in week view or a year in month view

#### Improved
• In dark mode, Keep, Contacts and Maps in the side panel go dark too, and grays like "Graphite" no longer look reddish
• On macOS, new installs keep desktop notifications on screen, and choosing "Persistent" for PowCal in System Settings does the same for existing installs
• Color labels you haven't named show their color's name in Time Insights and when you hover over the color in an opened event
• Birthdays show each person once, with their name as it appears in your contacts
• Smarter categorization, especially in other languages – e.g. with Google Calendar in French, "pain" (bread) no longer counts as sick
• Choosing a category is more reliable, and the picker says when others on the event won't see your choice
• Titles like "Dinner (time TBD)" now mark an event as tentative, while "Dinner (+ maybe Anna)" no longer does
• More title prefixes, like "Gym - Leg day", now show just "Leg day" beside the gym icon
• Updates downloaded in the background offer "Restart now" in a message at the top of the window instead of a prompt
• Various visual refinements and smaller improvements

#### Fixed
• Showing additional time zone labels only while you hold <kbd>Shift</kbd> works again after a Google Calendar update on Nov 19, 2026
• Tabs scroll in sync again after a Google Calendar update on Nov 12, 2026
• Vertical zoom works again after a Google Calendar update on Nov 10, 2026
• A color you picked and then discarded no longer shows on the event until you reload
• Deleting an event no longer leaves an empty row in the all-day section or in month view
• A location search in a tab left open for days no longer comes up empty the first time – a Google Calendar bug
• Choosing a category for a series no longer wipes the descriptions of separately edited events in it
• Auto-fill no longer skips the color when it moves an event to another calendar
• When you retitle an event, auto-fill no longer replaces a category you picked, and pressing Enter keeps the one it fills in
• Time fields work more reliably with AM/PM and in more languages and keyboard layouts
• Editing your own event with guests on the edit event page no longer shows a bar saying you invited yourself
• The gear button next to a Google Meet call now opens "Video call options"
• All-day invitations no longer disappear from PowCal's inbox too early or linger too long, depending on your time zone
• Events you organize no longer show up as invitations in the inbox when another app created them
• A tab no longer silently stops updating while you're still signed in to Google Calendar
• On macOS, a prompt left unanswered, like an update's, no longer holds up desktop notifications and calendar syncing
• On Windows, prompts now open centered on the window and no longer fall behind it
• CSV exports are more complete and accurate, and work even where Google Calendar's own export fails
• "Save as PDF" and CSV exports now follow your region's paper size and spreadsheet format
• Weather, maps and Join buttons work with locations in more languages
• Dates and wording in other languages now match Google Calendar's more closely
• In right-to-left languages like Hebrew and Arabic, the calendar now mirrors correctly
• Suggestion lists, menus and buttons now work better from the keyboard
• Smaller fixes throughout, from the sidebar and inbox to sign-in and app updates
